title: Poison Summon Raging Spirit Necromancer
overview:
Start with fire minions and swap to poison after sourcing the weapon and minion poison chance. Minions keep attacking while you reposition.

Build reference by BalorMage. Original guide: https://www.poe-vault.com/guides/balormage-summon-raging-spirits-necromancer-build-guide
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/7_6IS6EVRZfT

Campaign items illustrate equipment progression. Use linked campaign drops you can equip. Some utility groups in campaign sets become available in later acts. Check gem requirements and combat assumptions before purchasing gear. Set the character level when you switch loadouts.

stages.title: Act 1 · Start SRS at level 8
stages.goal: Use Freezing Pulse until SRS is available, then use the level 8 SRS group.
stages.priority: Take Summon Raging Spirit from Nessa after The Caged Brute and link it to Minion Damage.
stages.budget: Wear linked campaign drops and movement-speed boots.

stages.title: Acts 2–3 · Fire minions
stages.goal: Stay on hit-based SRS and level its supports.
stages.priority: Use a minion wand and keep resists up. Take Flesh Offering after Sever the Right Hand.
stages.budget: Wear linked campaign drops with life and resistances.

stages.title: Acts 4–10 · Campaign SRS
stages.goal: Follow the fire SRS socket groups through Kitava.
stages.priority: Get Unleash after The Eternal Nightmare. Fix resists and prepare life gear before maps.
stages.budget: Wear linked campaign drops with life and resistances.

stages.title: Atlas · Early endgame
stages.goal: Enter maps on the early SRS setup.
stages.priority: Aim for a six-link and reliable minion support.
stages.swap: Delay poison until you can supply poison chance and reliable chaos damage.

stages.title: Endgame · Poison SRS
stages.goal: Respec to poison-based SRS once the weapon and jewels are ready.
stages.priority: Check minion chance to poison and accuracy in PoB.
stages.swap: Acquire the poison package before spending refunds.

stages.title: Endgame · Min-max
stages.goal: Use the final socket and item setup for comparison.
stages.priority: Upgrade core poison and minion gear before luxury items.
